DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 卓球台をご利用になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to use a table-tennis table?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で使いたいです。ラケットを持っていませんが、借りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人卓球とラケット借用を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two of us would like to play. We do not have rackets; can we borrow some?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request table tennis for two and borrowing rackets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ラケット二本と球をお貸しします。利用枠は三十分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will lend you two rackets and a ball. Each session is thirty minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三十分でお願いします。初めてなので、台の番号も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三十分枠を選び台番号を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thirty minutes, please. This is our first time, so please tell us the table number too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose a thirty-minute session and ask the table number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二番の台です。用具をこの袋にまとめてお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is table two. We will put the equipment together in this bag for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二本と球を受け取りました。台まで行く前に、開始と終了の時刻を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 用具受領後の開始終了時刻を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We have received two rackets and a ball. Before going to the table, I would like to confirm the starting and finishing times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the starting and finishing times after receiving the equipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 開始は二時、終了は二時半です。返却もこちらでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It starts at two and ends at two thirty. Please return the equipment here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二時半にここへ戻します。台の周りにかばんを置く棚はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返却時刻を復唱しかばん棚を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will bring it back here at two thirty. Is there a shelf near the table for our bags?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat the return time and ask about a shelf for bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二番の横に棚があります。床を空けてご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is a shelf beside table two. Please keep the floor clear while playing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 棚にかばんを置きます。二番の台で二人で使い、用具は袋ごと返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 棚利用と二番台と袋返却を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will put our bags on the shelf. The two of us will use table two and return the equipment in its bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use the shelf and table two, then return the equipment in the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお楽しみください。ご利用ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy yourselves. Thank you for using our facilities.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 空港まで行きます。帰りはバスなので、片道の切符を買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空港行き片道切符を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going to the airport. I will return by bus, so I would like a one-way ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a one-way ticket to the airport. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 空港行きには、乗換えのない列車と途中で乗り換える列車があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: For the airport, there are trains without a transfer and trains requiring a transfer along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大きい荷物があるので、乗換えのない列車にしたいです。次は何時ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 荷物のため直通を選び発車時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have large luggage, so I would like a train without a transfer. What time is the next one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose a direct train because of your luggage and ask its departure time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 次の直通は十一時二十分です。今から十五分あります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The next direct train is at 11:20. You have fifteen minutes from now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その列車にします。普通の切符のほかに必要な券はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 直通列車の追加券を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will take that train. Do I need any other ticket besides an ordinary ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the direct train requires an additional ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この列車は特急券が必要です。普通乗車券と合わせた金額はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: This train requires a limited-express ticket. Here is the combined price with the ordinary fare ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 金額を確認しました。片道の乗車券と、この列車の特急券を一人分お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 運賃を了承し一人分二券を購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have checked the price. One one-way fare ticket and a limited-express ticket for this train, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept the fare and buy both tickets for one person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発行しました。座席は三号車の十二番Ａです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: They have been issued. Your seat is 12A in car three.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 片道と時刻と座席を確認しました。三号車の表示を見て乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 片道時刻座席を確認し三号車へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the one-way journey, time and seat. I will look for the sign for car three when boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the one-way journey, time and seat, then go to car three. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、よい旅を。お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Have a pleasant journey, then. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 分別の表をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like a waste-sorting chart?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。冷蔵庫に貼って家族で見たいので、文字の大きい表はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族閲覧用に大判分別表を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to put it on the refrigerator for my family to read. Do you have a chart with large lettering?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a large waste-sorting chart for your family to read. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: Ａ三の用紙があります。お住まいの地区を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have an A3 sheet. Please tell me which district you live in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 北地区です。曜日も載っていると便利なのですが、この表にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 北地区と収集曜日表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The northern district. It would be useful if the days of the week were listed too; does this chart have them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the northern district and ask whether collection days are shown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: これは品目の分け方だけです。北地区の収集日程は別の用紙になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This one only explains how to sort items. The northern district's collection schedule is on a separate sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 両方をください。分別表は大判、日程は持ちやすい普通の大きさで構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大判分別表と普通サイズ日程を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please give me both. I would like the large sorting chart, but an ordinary, easy-to-carry size is fine for the schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a large sorting chart and a normal-sized schedule. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの二枚です。分別表の裏にも品目が載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here are the two sheets. There are items on the back of the sorting chart too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 裏も家族に見せたいので、壁に貼る時は上だけ留めてめくれるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 裏面を見られる貼り方を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want my family to see the back too, so when I put it on the wall I will fasten only the top so it can be lifted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain how you will put it up so the back can be read. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 日程の地区名をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the district name on the schedule.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 北地区で合っています。二枚の役割が分かったので、家で並べて使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地区と二枚の用途を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: The northern district is correct. I understand the purpose of both sheets, so we will use them side by side at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the district and the uses of the two sheets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞご活用ください。ご来庁ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please make good use of them. Thank you for visiting the office.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 点滴中ですが、何かご用でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are having an IV infusion; is there something you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: トイレへ行きたいです。点滴をつけたまま、どう動けばよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 点滴中のトイレ移動方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need to use the toilet. How should I move while the IV is attached?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to move to the toilet while receiving an IV. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一緒に移動します。立つ前に、めまいやふらつきはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will go with you. Before you stand, do you feel dizzy or unsteady?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今はありません。ただ、管が椅子のひじ掛けに引っ掛かっているようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ふらつきなしと管の引掛かりを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not at the moment. But the tube seems to be caught on the chair's armrest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report no unsteadiness and that the tubing is caught. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外しました。点滴台をこちらへ動かしますので、ゆっくり立ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have freed it. I will move the IV stand this way; please stand up slowly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 立てました。台を押す手は、針の入っていない左手でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 立位後の台を押す手を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am standing. Should I push the stand with my left hand, which does not have the needle in it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After standing, ask which hand to use to push the stand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 左手でお願いします。管に余裕を持たせて、私も横で歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Use your left hand, please. We will leave slack in the tube, and I will walk beside you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 左手で持ちます。トイレの入口で台の車輪が止まったら、声を掛けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 左手使用と車輪停止時の声掛けを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use my left hand. If the stand's wheels get stuck at the toilet entrance, I will call you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will use your left hand and speak up if the wheels stop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。終わった後も、一人で戻る前に呼んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. When you are finished, please call me before returning on your own too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 戻る時も呼びます。まず一緒に入口までお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了後も呼び同行を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will call when returning too. Please come with me to the entrance first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will call after finishing and request accompaniment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご案内します。ゆっくりお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will show you the way. Please move slowly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 運転免許証を歩道で拾いました。人に踏まれそうだったので、ここへ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩道で拾った免許証を届ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a driver's license on the sidewalk. It looked as though someone might step on it, so I brought it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Hand in a driver's license found on the sidewalk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。拾った場所はどの辺りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. Around where did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 郵便局の入口から駅へ向かう歩道です。花壇の手前に落ちていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 郵便局と花壇で拾得場所を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: On the sidewalk leading from the post office entrance toward the station. It was lying just before the flower bed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the finding location using the post office and flower bed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拾った時刻も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also tell me when you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十分くらい前です。免許証だけで、財布は周りに見当たりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十分前と免許証単独を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: About ten minutes ago. It was only the license; I did not see a wallet nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that it was ten minutes ago and only the license was there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 免許証はこちらでお預かりします。拾った状況を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will keep the license here. We will record how it was found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。氏名を読んで自分で訪ねるより、ここで持ち主へつないでもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 警察への持主対応を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Rather than reading the name and going to visit the person myself, I would like you to connect it with the owner here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the police to handle contacting the owner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 警察で対応します。こちらに、お届けの控えをお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The police will take care of it. Here is a receipt for handing it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えを受け取りました。拾った場所と時刻は記載どおりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えを受領し場所時刻を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have received the receipt. The location and time I found it are as written.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the receipt and confirm the location and time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お届けありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for handing it in. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: はがきを出す準備ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you getting a postcard ready to send?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。宛先を書いたら、自分の住所を書く場所が分からなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: はがきの差出人欄の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. After writing the recipient's address, I am unsure where to write my own address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where the postcard's sender section is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表の左下が差出人の欄です。今どこまで記入しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The sender section is at the lower left on the front. How much have you filled in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 宛先は右側へ書きました。裏は写真でいっぱいなので、表の空いている所を使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表の宛先記入済と写真の裏面を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrote the recipient's address on the right. The back is completely covered by a photo, so I want to use the blank space on the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the recipient's address is on the front and the back has a photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 左下にご自身の住所とお名前を書けます。郵便番号も入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can write your address and name at the lower left. Please include your postal code too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この七けたを先に書きます。相手の郵便番号の枠とは別で、左下に書くのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 差出人郵便番号の位置を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write these seven digits first. So they go at the lower left, separate from the recipient's postal-code boxes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm where to write the sender's postal code. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。文字が宛先の欄に重ならないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please make sure your writing does not overlap the recipient section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 左下へ書けました。住所が長いので二行にしましたが、読みやすいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 長い住所の二行表記の読取を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have written it at the lower left. My address is long, so I used two lines; is it easy to read?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether your long address written over two lines is readable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二行とも読めます。お名前まで入っていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Both lines are readable. Your name is included too, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の住所と名前が入りました。このはがきを一枚出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所氏名完成後にはがきを差し出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: My own address and name are there. I will send this one postcard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the postcard after completing your address and name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。お預かりします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will take it. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 両替機のことでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the currency-exchange machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 結婚のお祝い用に、一万円の新しいお札を三枚用意したいです。機械で選べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 祝い用の一万円新札三枚の入手を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like three new 10,000-yen notes for a wedding gift. Can I choose new notes on the machine?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to obtain three new 10,000-yen notes for a celebration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの機械は新札指定ができません。窓口で在庫を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This machine does not let you specify new notes. We will check availability at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 窓口でお願いします。三万円分の現金を持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 窓口利用と三万円所持を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the counter, please. I have 30,000 yen in cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request the counter and state that you have 30,000 yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今は一万円の新札が三枚あります。両替手数料はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We currently have three new 10,000-yen notes. Here is the exchange fee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この手数料でお願いします。三枚を折らずに持ち帰れる封筒もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手数料を了承し折らず持帰る封筒を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do it for that fee. Do you also have an envelope so I can take the three notes home without folding them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accept the fee and request an envelope to take the notes home unfolded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 封筒をお渡しできます。まず現金をトレーへお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can provide an envelope. Please put the cash in the tray first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三万円を出しました。新札は祝儀袋に入れるので、封筒に平らに入れて持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三万円を出し平らな収納を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have put down 30,000 yen. The new notes will go in a wedding-gift envelope, so I will take them home flat in this envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Put down 30,000 yen and explain keeping the notes flat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが新札三枚です。枚数と金額をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here are the three new notes. Please check their number and total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一万円札が三枚、三万円です。確認したので封筒に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新札の枚数金額を確認して封筒へ入れる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Three 10,000-yen notes, totaling 30,000 yen. I have checked them and will put them in the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the number and value of new notes, then put them in the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 両替は以上です。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: That completes the exchange. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 朝食の品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for breakfast items?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日は早く出るので、火を使わずに食べられる物をそろえたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 火を使わない翌朝の朝食を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am leaving early tomorrow, so I want to get food I can eat without using the stove.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Look for breakfast for tomorrow that requires no cooking flame. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: パンとヨーグルトならそのまま召し上がれます。冷蔵庫は使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Bread and yogurt can be eaten as they are. Do you have a refrigerator available?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家の冷蔵庫を使えます。ヨーグルトは一人分ずつの容器がよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 冷蔵庫使用可と一人分容器を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can use my refrigerator at home. I would like yogurt in individual servings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you can use a refrigerator and request single-serving containers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 四個入りと二個入りがあります。何人分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are packs of four and packs of two. How many people is it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二人分です。二個入りを一つと、個包装のパンを二つ選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人分としてヨーグルトとパンを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two people. I will choose one two-pack and two individually wrapped breads.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose yogurt and bread for two people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: パンはこちらです。飲み物もお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The bread is here. Are you looking for drinks too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。小さい牛乳を二本ください。持ち歩くのでなく、出る前に家で飲みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家で飲む小さい牛乳二本を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Two small bottles of milk, please. We will drink them at home before leaving, rather than carrying them with us.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request two small bottles of milk to drink at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 小さい牛乳は冷蔵棚の下段です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The small bottles of milk are on the bottom shelf of the refrigerated section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二本を取りました。パン二つ、ヨーグルト二個、牛乳二本で、二人の朝食がそろいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人分の全品がそろったと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have taken two. Two breads, two yogurts and two bottles of milk: breakfast for two is ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you have all the items for two people's breakfast. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞレジへお進みください。お買物ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed to the checkout. Thank you for shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 池の鳥をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to look at the birds on the pond?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 遠くてよく見えません。貸出しの双眼鏡を使ってみたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遠い鳥を見る双眼鏡を借りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: They are too far away to see clearly. I would like to try the binoculars you lend out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to borrow binoculars to see the distant birds. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一台お貸しします。首に掛けるひもも付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will lend you one pair. It also has a neck strap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 首に掛けました。両目の幅は、この真ん中を動かして合わせますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 首ひも装着と目幅調整を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have put the strap around my neck. Do I move this middle section to adjust the distance between my eyes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have put on the strap and ask how to adjust the eye spacing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。丸い視野が一つに見えるように調整してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Adjust it until you see one circular field of view.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一つに見えましたが、鳥がぼやけています。どこでピントを合わせますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 視野調整後のピント操作を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I see one circle now, but the birds are blurry. Where do I adjust the focus?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After adjusting the view, ask how to operate the focus. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 上のつまみです。まず岸の看板で合わせると分かりやすいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Use the knob on top. It is easier to start by focusing on the sign on the bank.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 看板がはっきりしました。池の奥の鳥も見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 看板と鳥が明瞭になったと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The sign is clear now. I can also see the birds at the far end of the pond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that the sign and birds are clear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 観察が終わったら、受付へお戻しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you finish watching, please return it to reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ひもを使って観察します。終わったらレンズに指を触れず、受付へ返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ひも利用と受付返却を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use the strap while watching. When finished, I will return it to reception without touching the lenses with my fingers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use the strap and return the binoculars to reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ鳥の姿をお楽しみください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27228-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy watching the birds. Goodbye, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご乗車のお手伝いをご希望ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。車椅子で乗りたいので、扉との段差にスロープを使ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車椅子乗車の段差にスロープ補助を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am boarding in a wheelchair; could you use a ramp over the step at the door?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a ramp to help a wheelchair cross the step when boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 降りる駅と、予定している列車を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me your destination station and which train you plan to take.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二駅先へ、次の普通列車で行きたいです。降りる時にもスロープをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二駅先と次普通列車と降車補助希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to go two stations ahead on the next local train. Please provide a ramp when I get off too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State two stations ahead, the next local train, and your need for help alighting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 降車駅の係員へ連絡します。こちらでは車椅子を押すお手伝いも必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will contact the staff at your destination. Do you also need help pushing the wheelchair here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 平らな所は自分で進めます。スロープを渡る時だけ、後ろを支えてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自走できる範囲とスロープ後方支持を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can move by myself on level ground. I would only like you to support me from behind while crossing the ramp.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify where you can move yourself and the support from behind needed on the ramp. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。列車が着いて、スロープを設置したらお声を掛けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We will call you when the train arrives and the ramp has been set up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。車椅子に掛けた袋は膝の上に移したので、車輪に触れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋を膝へ移し車輪との接触を防ぐ準備を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I have moved the bag hanging on the wheelchair onto my lap, so it will not touch the wheels.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report moving the bag onto your lap to keep it clear of the wheels. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: スロープを設置しました。後ろを支えますので、ゆっくりお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The ramp is in place. I will support you from behind; please move forward slowly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乗れました。お手伝いありがとうございます。降りる駅でも係員が来るまで扉の手前で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗車成功を伝え降車係員を待つと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I am on board. Thank you for your help. At my destination, I will also wait in front of the door until the staff arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm boarding successfully and waiting for the alighting staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 降車のお手伝いも手配しています。それでは、お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27229-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have arranged help at your destination too. Take care and have a good trip.
